title: Net Energy Metering Rider Terms — Expiry Share by Years in Operation
content:
The share of unused carried Net Energy Metering credit that expires at the anniversary true-up falls as the agreement's time in operation grows.

**Rule.** When the whole calendar months from the permission to operate date to the expiry are at least the long-tenure months of 60, the expiry share is the long-tenure expiry share of 0.50. When they are at least the mid-tenure months of 24 but below 60, it is the mid-tenure expiry share of 0.75. Below 24 months no reduced expiry share applies.

The permission to operate date is the date recorded on the agreement; the expiry is the day the expiry is booked.

## Expiry share

| Whole calendar months from permission to operate to the expiry | Expiry share |
|---|---|
| 60 or more | 0.50 |
| 24 to 59 | 0.75 |
| Fewer than 24 | No reduced share |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- Permission to operate on 12 August; expiry booked on 11 August five years later: 59 whole months, so 0.75. Booked on 12 August five years later: 60 months, so 0.50.
- Expiry booked on 11 August two years after permission to operate: 23 months, no reduced share; on 12 August two years after, 24 months, so 0.75.
